summary: Very steep residential kerb with homes close on both sides.

best_section.where: North kerb just off the main road, Bishop Street

drivers.seclusion: Homes 7 to 20 m away along the whole kerb, with apartments just beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; few cars park, verge is fenced gardens and trees.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street, busy road at the bottom end.
drivers.convention: Some residents park along the street; no camping convention.

sun_shade: Heavy tree cover and building shade along the north side.
